verdict.rationale: Babylon.js offers real profiling/debugging tools — the Inspector for runtime scene analysis and Spector.js for WebGL debugging — which cover the 'real profiler' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of data-oriented scaling paths like an ECS, job/worker system, or GPU instancing; community comments even flag GC-pressure concerns from heavy object allocation, suggesting the opposite of a data-oriented design in some APIs. missing for 10: ECS architecture, job/task system, instancing support, independent benchmarks showing scaling under heavy scenes.
